prompt: Install ChromaNeural {version} for this user? Python 3.14 with Tk and Node.js 24 are required.
finish: Installation finished. See the installation log if an error occurred.
existing: Existing installation is preserved. Choose a new destination.
new_destination: Choose a NEW destination; existing files will never be replaced.
outside: Destination must be outside this package.
linked_install: Linked installation paths are not supported: {path}
missing_manifest: Missing SHA256SUMS.txt; use a complete verified release.
unmanifested: Unmanifested payload file; use a clean release: {path}
destination_appeared: Destination appeared during installation; existing files are preserved.
verified: Payload SHA-256 verified before and after copying. Installed SHA256SUMS.txt covers the installed payload.
boundaries: No autostart, identity copy, online enrollment or system configuration changes. Python/Tk and optional WSL providers are separate prerequisites.
